# Closing conditions corpus fixture pack

These literal extracts are the approved 2026-08-02 corpus evidence. The
filename prefix is the source card identifier. They support only synthetic
resolver and lexicon tests until a dated live-run recording exists.

`c5b50bfe` is QXO/TopBuild section 5.2(a). Its compound-clause test runs at
the resolver layer only. The capitalisation scope fence excludes that section
from closing-conditions prompt dispatch.
